title: 'The Recall's Three Notes' quest text reads as an OR ('the last waits with Hollis, the lodge hall's roll, or Fry — whichever you haven't tried'), implying any one source fills the missing note. In practice status tracked 2/3 with the lodge hall specifically still required — the three sources give three different, non-interchangeable notes, not alternate routes to the same one.
